stores-footer-remove-all-anonymous.back: Enter: remove all { -device } that joined via the link

stores-footer-remove-anonymous.back: Enter: remove this { -device }, of which only the join time is known

stores-footer-revoked.back: This { -store } does not accept this { -device }. The owner can send a new invitation.

stores-footer-update-hosts.back: This update also asks to connect to { $hosts }

stores-footer-you.back: You are the owner. A { -store } always has an owner.

stores-intro.back: { -plugin-cap-pl } add { -source-pl }. Each one lists the hosts it connects to before you install.

stores-invite-once.back: Can be used once. Only the person you sent it to can use it.

stores-invite-preview-safe.back: Opening it in a browser shows how to join and does not use up the invitation.

stores-join-already.back: Already joined. Joining again issues a new token to this { -device }.

stores-join-anonymous.back: Joins without a name, and other { -device } also join with the same link.

stores-join-detail.back: Paste the link you received from the operator of the { -plugin-store }.

stores-join-detail-desktop.back: Paste the invitation link you received from the operator of the { -plugin-store }. Before joining or installing, you can check what the { -plugin-store } offers.

stores-join-detail-opened.back: Paste the link you received from the operator of the { -plugin-store }. An { -app-name }:// invitation link opened from a messaging app is entered directly into this sheet.

stores-join-device-note.back: The { -store } owner sees this name. Type to change it.

stores-join-installs-nothing.back: Joining installs nothing. You can choose yourself which { -plugin-pl } to install. Each asks you to confirm the hosts it connects to.

stores-join-open.back: Anyone who knows the link can join.

stores-leave-plugins.back: { -plugin-cap-pl } installed from this { -store } stay on this device and are no longer updated.

stores-leave-rejoin.back: { -plugin-cap-pl } installed from there stay installed. To join again you need to get a new invitation from the operator.

stores-leave-revoked.back: This { -device }'s access to the { -store } will be revoked.

stores-link-copied.back: Copied to the clipboard if the terminal supports it. If not, select it and copy.

stores-link-device-detail.back: Creates a link to open on another { -device } you have.

stores-link-once-until.back: Open this link on another { -device }. Can be used once, until { $until }.

stores-link-send-once.back: Send this link to { $who }. It can be used once and is valid until { $until }.

stores-link-send-once-anyone.back: Send this link to the intended person. It can be used once and is valid until { $until }.

stores-link-sheet-detail.back: If you open this link on another { -device }, you can join the { -plugin-store } there. The link can be used only once.

stores-no-invites.back: No pending invitations. Invitation links appear here until they are used.

stores-no-longer-joined.back: You have not joined this { -plugin-store } any more.

stores-not-an-invite.back: This is not an invitation link.

stores-not-from-app.back: { -plugin-cap-pl } are provided by the operator of the { -plugin-store }, not by { -app-name }. You can leave the { -plugin-store } at any time.

stores-note-offline.back: You are offline. Showing the last list received ({ $reason })

stores-note-revoked.back: This { -store } does not accept this { -device }. Things already installed keep working.

stores-offline-keep-working.back: It didn't respond the last time this { -device } asked. Installed { -plugin-pl } keep working.

stores-offline-last-list.back: You're offline ({ $reason }). The { -plugin-pl } below are the list as last confirmed.

stores-offline-last-list-plain.back: You're offline. Showing the list last received.

stores-open-anyone.back: Anyone who knows the { -store } link can join without a name.

stores-open-heading.back: Anyone who knows the link can join · { $joined } joined

stores-open-join-off-detail.back: Only people you invite can join. If you turn it on, anyone with the link can join without a name.

stores-open-join-on-detail.back: People can join without a name. If you turn it off the link stops working, and turning it on again makes a new link.

stores-open-link-lasts.back: Valid until the { -store } returns to invite-only.

stores-open-link-new.back: A new link is issued each time, so earlier links become unusable.

stores-open-link-warning.back: Someone with the link can join any number of times without a name.

stores-open-members-see.back: Members see that the { -store } is open via a link.

stores-open-off-detail.back: Only invited people can join. Turning it on lets anyone with the link join without a name.

stores-open-on-detail.back: People can join without a name. Turning it off stops the link; turning it on again makes a new link.

stores-owner-link-offline.back: Creating a link requires a connection to { -plugin-store }.

stores-owner-needs-connection-detail.back: Try again once this { -device } is back online.

stores-owner-sees-as.back: The name of this { -device } shown to the owner

stores-page-closes.back: This page closes together with this screen, or after 10 minutes.

stores-plugin-added-by-hand-note.back: { $id }.wasm was added manually and is already in the { -plugin } folder.

stores-plugin-cannot.back: It cannot read files, open sockets or inspect the environment.

stores-plugin-limits.back: Each { -plugin } can connect only to the hosts in its list and cannot read your files.

stores-plugin-limits-short.back: { -plugin-cap-pl } can neither read your files nor connect to hosts not in the list.

stores-plugin-other-store-note.back: Installed from another { -store } and updated there.

stores-plugin-update-adds.back: This update adds { $hosts } to the hosts it can connect to.

stores-publish-none.back: This { -device } has no { -plugin-pl } that can be published.

stores-qr-instructions.back: Scan the QR code with your smartphone and paste the invitation link of the { -plugin-store } into the page that opens.

stores-remove-devices-title.back: Remove the { -device-pl } that joined from the link?

stores-remove-member-detail.back: This person's { -device-pl } will no longer be able to access this { -plugin-store }. Installed { -plugin-cap-pl } keep working, but updates are stopped.

stores-remove-member-devices.back: That member's { $count } { -device-pl } become unusable on this { -store } immediately.

stores-remove-member-plugins.back: Already installed { -plugin-cap-pl } remain on that member's devices.

stores-remove-plugin-detail.back: It will be removed from this { -device }. You can install it again from the { -plugin-store }.

stores-replace-by-hand-detail.back: { $version } from { $store } will replace the copy you added by hand.

stores-replace-label.back: Replace the copy of { $name } added manually

stores-send-link-until.back: Send this link. It can be used once and is valid until { $until }.

stores-server-older.back: The server of this { -plugin-store } is old and only lets invited people join. Updating adds options.

stores-toast-that-is-you.back: That is you yourself. A { -store } always has an owner.

stores-unpublish-members.back: Members who installed it can keep using it, but it is no longer updated.

stores-unreachable.back: Couldn't connect to { -plugin-store }. Check the link and your connection, then try again.

torrents-off-detail.back: Off by default. When you turn it on, it first asks how to protect your connection.

torrents-page-fill-form.back: Fill in the form and submit again.

torrents-page-look-at-tv.back: Look at the TV: { $next }. You can close this page.

torrents-page-missing-key.back: This address has no key. Scan the TV's QR code again and open the full address shown.

torrents-page-needs-script.back: This page needs JavaScript to send the form's content to the TV safely.

torrents-page-unreadable.back: The TV could not read this content. Scan the TV's QR code again.

torrents-password-keep.back: Leave blank to use the saved password.

torrents-protect-none-note.back: Without protection, { -app-name } does not check the connection.

torrents-protect-vpn-detail.back: Uses the VPN already running on this { -device }.

torrents-protection-not-saved.back: Not saved. Because { $why }, the saved protection settings stay as they are.

torrents-proxy-invalid.back: A proxy needs a host and a port number from 1 to 65535.

torrents-proxy-not-saved.back: Not saved. Because { $why }, the saved proxy stays as it is.

torrents-sheet-proxy-auth-note.back: Enter only if the proxy asks for a username and password.

torrents-summary-vpn.back: Protected by the VPN on this { -device }.

torrents-warn-instead.back: { -app-name } does not pause but shows a warning. If the VPN or proxy is down, others may see your IP address.

tray-where.back: It is in the notification area.

tui-config-problem.back: { $file }: { $what }. Using defaults until it is fixed.

tui-config-problem-at-line.back: { $file } line { $line }: { $what }. Using defaults until it is fixed.

tv-forget-detail.back: To play again, pair once more.

tv-looking.back: Looking for TVs on this network

tv-none-found-detail.back: Check that { -app-name } is open on the TV and that it's on the same Wi-Fi as this { -device }.

tv-none-found-short.back: Check that { -app-name } is open on the TV.

tv-none-paired-detail.back: Open { -app-name } on the TV, connect to the same Wi-Fi, then pair here.

tv-open-on-tv.back: Open { -app-name } on your TV. It must be on the same Wi-Fi as this { -device }.

tv-pair-request-detail.back: Enter this code on the phone.

tv-problem-gone.back: That TV is no longer on the network.

tv-problem-not-a-link.back: That is not a TV pairing code or address.

tv-problem-version.back: The TV is running a different version of { -app-name }. Update both to the same version.

tv-problem-wrong-code.back: The code did not match. Check the code shown on the TV and try again.

tv-remove-phone-detail.back: It can no longer be used as a remote for this TV. You can pair again with a new code.

tv-row-away.back: Paired. Not found on this network

tv-row-needs-update.back: Needs the same { -app-name } version as this { -device }

tv-row-paired-away.back: Paired. Not found on this network

tv-scan-hint.back: Scan the TV's code with the camera app. { -app-name } opens and pairs.

tv-sheet-scan.back: Scan the code on the TV

tv-talk-failed.back: The connection to the TV was lost. Check that it's on and on the same network, and try again.
